Everyday I meet so many people who ask me the same question.
Which Mutual Fund should they buy!
And I understand the confusion there are more than 2000 mutual funds available in India and each of them promise to give the best returns !
But are returns the only thing that matters?
In this video we discuss
What actually is the most important criteria to analyse a mutual fund (Trust me returns are not enough!)
We discuss what are some qualitative factors you should look for before selecting a mutual fund.
